items.title: Gucci's new 'Made in China' sneaker models break with Italian tradition
items.summary: Gucci began selling its Demna-designed Drip sneaker and a slip-on leather model labeled Made in China, priced around EUR800/USD1,000, breaking with Italian-manufacturing tradition. Berenberg analysts warned of tension between provenance and luxury positioning; a Milan consultant said Made in China 'is not a good look'; Barclays' Carole Madjo questioned whether falling prices should affect purchase intent.

items.title: Gucci打破传统推中国制造运动鞋 业内人士恐削弱品牌形象
items.summary: Chinese-language coverage of the same Drip sneaker story for a Hong Kong/China audience, emphasizing industry warnings that abandoning Made in Italy could weaken Gucci's premium image as it courts middle-class shoppers amid a sales slump that cut revenue by half over three years.

items.title: Gucci cuts prices, but will Chinese shoppers return?
items.summary: Jing Daily analysis on Gucci/Kering cutting prices on select handbag lines in China (e.g., Ophidia mini bucket bag from RMB12,300 to RMB8,700), reporting that Chinese consumers are approaching the move cautiously, questioning luxury value-for-money and in some cases favoring gold over bags while waiting for further cuts.

items.title: グッチが中国で異例の大幅値下げ、一部バッグは3割近く引き下げ
items.summary: Japanese-language report on Gucci's unusual China price cuts of up to ~29% on models like the Ophidia mini bucket and Mercato tote, noting analysts see it as Gucci's biggest self-initiated markdown in a decade, driven by Kering's weak China performance, with a caution that repeated markdowns risk eroding brand premium.

items.title: "할머니 집 같아" 탄식…구찌 매장 '폐쇄 선언' 초유의 사태
items.summary: Korean business press coverage describing unprecedented Gucci store closures amid a sales collapse, with commentary that outdated store design ('like grandma's house') is contributing to declining footfall in Korea; part of a broader wave of luxury brand downsizing.

items.title: "84곳 문 닫았다"…매장 줄이는 명품 브랜드의 속내
items.summary: Korean report that Kering closed 84 stores in H1 2026 (25 regular department-store locations and 11 outlet stores for Gucci specifically), with Kering targeting roughly 125 Gucci store closures by 2030 as part of a profitability turnaround; about 10 of Gucci's 46 Korean stores are reportedly under review for exit.

items.title: 누구나 원하는 모습으로 살아가는 법, 구찌 2027 봄/여름 컬렉션
items.summary: Vogue Korea's review of Demna's second Gucci runway show, 'The Store Show,' staged inside a constructed Gucci store in Milan. The piece gives an independent critical verdict, praising the 'twisted preps' section as most convincing and calling the finale gown breathtaking, while noting Demna's growth beyond his usual register.

items.title: 구찌의 본질을 자신만의 언어로 재정의한 뎀나, '더 스토어 쇼'
items.summary: GQ Korea's descriptive write-up of the Store Show, chronicling design elements and character archetypes (Rebellious Aristocrat, Snob, Eccentric) without an independent evaluative verdict on the collection's creative success — classified as activation-adjacent coverage under the descriptive-writeup rule.

items.title: Gucci names Chinese actress Tian Xiwei brand ambassador
items.summary: Gucci promoted Chinese actress Tian Xiwei (13M+ Weibo followers) from brand friend to full brand ambassador after nearly three years of campaign appearances; she is set to attend the Milan SS27 show in the new role. Purely descriptive activation announcement.

items.source: Weibo (via Sina republish, #田曦薇确认出席米兰时装周# topic)
items.title: 田曦薇是谁？一文看懂新晋GUCCI品牌大使米兰时装周出发为何引爆期待
items.summary: Weibo/Sina fan-media coverage reports the hashtag #田曦薇确认出席米兰时装周# surpassed 100 million reads within two days of the ambassador announcement; commentary framed her styling versatility positively and noted her expanding luxury/beauty/auto endorsement portfolio. Classic idol/fandom activation spike, damped under fandom-trap guidance.

items.title: 古驰最高降价40%！奢侈品"只涨不降"神话破灭？深度解析
items.summary: Weibo long-form post arguing Gucci's price cuts (up to 40% on some styles by the poster's own-denominator method) break the luxury-brand only-goes-up pricing myth; frames it as a buying opportunity for personal use but a resale-value risk, citing an unnamed influencer's line that 'consumers no longer blindly buy inflated brand premiums.' Account shows repetitive FAQ-formula posting typical of a content-farm operator rather than an individual consumer; treated as opinion-thermometer signal only, not amplified.

items.title: 구찌의자 온 침착맨
items.summary: Korean community (FM Korea real-time best) thread referencing a popular streamer/personality appearing on a 'Gucci chair' in a livestream moment; light, incidental brand mention circulating on a general entertainment community rather than substantive brand commentary — recorded as neutral incidental buzz.

items.title: 뎀나가 구찌의 엔진에 시동을 걸었다
items.summary: Vogue Korea commentary crediting Demna with reigniting momentum at Gucci through his second collection, offering an independent positive critical take on his creative direction trajectory since joining, tying it to early signs of stabilizing brand buzz.

items.title: 명품 매출 20% 뛸 때 불만도 같이 뛰었다…10건 중 8건 '품질 불만'
items.summary: Korean Consumer Agency data: 674 luxury-brand damage-relief claims across 13 major brands from 2021 through Aug 2026, 77.2% quality-related; Louis Vuitton, Dior, Burberry, Prada and Chanel topped the complaint rankings. Gucci was not named among the top five or cited with specific figures in this piece, so it is included only as sector-context; no Gucci-specific mention count is attributable to this item.
